tone.target: raw ZZ Top blues-rock crunch with slight fuzz bite
tone.profile: raw ZZ Top blues-rock crunch with slight fuzz bite
tone.summary: A gritty, mid-focused signal chain utilizing a Boost or OD pedal followed by the UK 45/UK 50 model to capture ZZ Top's signature raw blues crunch with added fuzz texture.
corrections: replace mid-gain overdrive focus with raw fuzz-tinged crunch

rig.name: ZZ Top - Just Got Paid - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise inherent in raw blues rock recordings.
Provide the necessary tight grit and upper-mid bite for rhythm attack without sounding like polite overdrive.
blocks.gap: The Boost pedal is used to simulate a light, aggressive boost/overdrive effect, replacing the assumed Tube Screamer while maintaining tightness.

blocks.purpose: Introduce the required slight fuzz texture and raw bite without resorting to modern high-gain sounds.
blocks.gap: Red Haze provides a vintage, aggressive grit suitable for blues rock, fulfilling the 'slight fuzz' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Plexi/Marshall-style amp tone, providing the core raw blues crunch and upper-mid focus.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound associated with blues-rock and Marshall tones.
Enhance the upper-mid bite and cut any excessive low end, focusing on the raw rhythm attack.
Add a subtle, aggressive wah sweep for blues flair (optional but enhances the genre feel).
blocks.gap: The V-Wah is used as an optional texture element; if too much movement is desired, this block can be bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Add minimal, subtle echo to keep the tone dry and aggressive while adding depth.
blocks.gap: The settings are kept extremely low (low feedback/mix) to avoid 'lush reverb' or noticeable ambience, maintaining a raw feel.

blocks.purpose: Provide the bare minimum of natural room ambience without sounding overly processed or lush.
blocks.gap: The mix is kept very low to avoid violating the 'avoid lush reverb' rule, providing only subtle space.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default IR for a more vintage, raw 4x12 model.

proposals.reason: Enhance raw, vintage blues-rock grit and bite.
